title: Madras High Court (First Bench: CJ Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, Justice G. Arul Murugan) reserved orders on Wed 11 Nov 2026, no date given, on CREDAI-Chennai and others' petitions against the NGT Southern Zone's Sept 2025 ban on new construction approvals within 1 km of the Pallikaranai marsh (Ramsar site, 1,247.54 ha); TN State Wetlands Authority proposes a 128.19 ha interim Zone of Influence in 36 survey numbers with site-specific regulation, not a blanket ban (The Hindu 12 Nov, Dinamani 12 Nov)
